title: There's a bone in your body that isn't connected to any other bone
voiceover: There's a bone in your body that isn't connected to any other bone. It just floats. It's called the hyoid, a small horseshoe-shaped bone in your throat, held in place only by muscles and ligaments. It lets you talk, swallow, and breathe. And here's the dark part: forensic investigators check this bone first when they suspect strangulation. Because the hyoid is one of the only bones that almost always breaks during it. So this tiny floating bone... it's basically a witness. Follow for one mind-blowing fact a day.
